Reddet: ileti SMTP'de reddedilir, gönder: Reject: the message is rejected during SMTP and the sender is told. Quarantine: the message is accepted but not delivered to the recipient; release or delete it from the Quarantine tab, and it is deleted automatically after 14 days.
Başlıklar ve gövdenin ilk 64 KB'ı ham me: Headers and the first 64 KB of the body are shown as raw text.
İletinin tamamı gösterilmiyor; ilk 64 KB: The whole message is not shown; only the first 64 KB was read.
İleti bırakıldı; alıcıya teslim ediliyor: Message released; it is being delivered to the recipient
{sender} adresinden gelen ileti, istenme: The message from {sender} was caught as spam. If you release it, it is delivered to the recipients' inboxes.
{sender} adresinden gelen ileti kalıcı o: The message from {sender} is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
{count} ileti kalıcı olarak silinir. Bu: {count} messages are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
Reddetme eşiğini aşan iletiler reddedilm: Messages above the reject threshold are held here instead of being rejected; they are not delivered to the recipient. Messages older than {days} days are deleted automatically.
Karantina kipi kapalı: reddetme eşiğini: Quarantine mode is off: messages above the reject threshold are rejected during SMTP. An administrator can turn it on in the Spam tab; only messages held earlier appear here.
Only the newest 300 messages are shown.
